Entry-Level Remote Operations Assistant

Sample StaffingRemote (Canada)Posted Sep 6, 2026

RemoteInternshipNo ExperienceDemo listing

About this role

Sample listing for a four-month paid internship supporting the operations team with reporting, scheduling and process documentation.

Responsibilities

  • Compile weekly operational reports from existing dashboards
  • Keep shift schedules and trackers current
  • Document repeatable processes as short written guides
  • Support the team with ad-hoc research tasks

Requirements

  • Currently studying or recently graduated
  • Comfortable with spreadsheets
  • Willing to ask questions and learn quickly
  • Located in Canada

Benefits

  • Structured mentorship and weekly one-to-ones
  • Paid internship, fully remote
  • Reference and possible full-time offer on completion

Skills

OperationsSpreadsheetsReportingDocumentationOrganisation
